description: Search Instagram. type=media (default) searches the media grid — the same results as the keyword search page (instagram.com/explore/search/keyword/?q=...), which is also where hashtag pages redirect, so searching "#ai" or "ai" browses that tag. type=accounts searches accounts via the search-box suggestion API, returning username, display name, avatar, follower-count text, and verification badge. Media results preserve native post fields with cursor pagination; partial=true when the stream is exhausted. Requires a logged-in Instagram session.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search query. For type=media, keywords or hashtags (with or without "#"); for type=accounts, a name or username fragment. (搜索词：media 模式关键词或话题标签，# 可带可不带；accounts 模式搜账号名/用户名)

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: What to search: media (default, posts/reels grid — also covers hashtag browsing since instagram.com/explore/tags/{tag}/ redirects to keyword search) | accounts (user profiles via the search suggestion API). (搜索类型：media=帖子/Reels 网格（默认，含标签浏览）；accounts=账号搜索)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum results (1-100, default 20). Media paginates by cursor internally; accounts returns the API's top suggestions (usually 5) and marks partial=true when the limit cannot be reached. (返回条数上限；media 内部游标分页；accounts 固定返回 top-5，无法满足 limit 时标记 partial)
